title: zazzled operations
description: The zazzled binary's own subcommands. The zazzle commands they serve are described in cmd/; `zazzled proxy` and `zazzled wrap` in proxy/ and wrap/. A failure prints `zazzled: ...` on standard error and exits 2.

entities.name: zazzled serve
entities.description: Runs the daemon on the unix socket until it has been idle long enough.
entities.transport: zazzled serve [--socket PATH] [--idle SECS]; started by the invoker, by the MCP front end or by launchd
entities.authorization: Whoever can run the binary; the socket it creates is mode 0600 in a 0700 directory, and each connection is served only if its peer has the daemon's uid.
entities.result: Serves connections; exits after --idle seconds (default from ZAZZLE_IDLE_SECS, else 1800) with no connection open, flushing the cache and removing a socket it bound itself (launchd's socket stays).
failures: A daemon already answers on the socket: `a daemon is already running`.
The socket cannot be bound, or HOME is unset when no socket is given.
A bad --socket or --idle value, or an unknown option.

entities.name: zazzled mcp
entities.description: An MCP server on standard input and output in front of the daemon.
entities.transport: zazzled mcp, started by an MCP client; newline-delimited JSON-RPC: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call
entities.authorization: The MCP client that started the process; tool calls go to the daemon as the same user, with this process's working directory as the root.
entities.result: Tools zazzle_find, zazzle_read, zazzle_read_again, zazzle_ls, zazzle_outline, zazzle_refs and zazzle_edit, each answered with the command's text and isError when its status is not 0; runs until standard input closes.
failures: A line that is not JSON: error -32700.
An unknown method: -32601; an unknown tool: -32602.
A wrong argument type or a missing required argument: a tool result with isError and `error: ...`.
The daemon cannot be reached or started: a tool result with isError and `error: cannot reach zazzled: ...`.

entities.name: zazzled install
entities.description: Installs the LaunchAgent so launchd owns the socket and starts the daemon on demand.
entities.authorization: The user, in their own gui launchd domain; nothing else is checked.
entities.result: Writes ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.zazzle.zazzled.plist for this executable and the socket path, unloads any loaded copy and bootstraps it; prints `installed PATH`.
failures: Not macOS: `install is for macOS launchd; elsewhere the invoker starts zazzled on demand`.
launchctl bootstrap fails or takes more than 10 seconds.

entities.name: zazzled uninstall
entities.description: Unloads the LaunchAgent and removes its plist.
entities.authorization: The user, in their own gui launchd domain.
entities.result: `removed PATH`, or `not installed` when there was no plist.
failures: The plist exists but cannot be removed.

entities.name: zazzled run
entities.description: Runs one zazzle command in this process, without a daemon.
entities.transport: zazzled run CMD .. (not `zazzle run`, which is `zazzled wrap`)
entities.authorization: The caller's own permissions; edits are confined to the current directory as for any caller.
entities.result: The command's output on standard output, or its error on standard error, and its status as the exit code; uses ZAZZLE_SESSION, standard input and the current directory but no persistent cache. clean outputs go to the output store, and read-again finds them there.
failures: Whatever the command itself refuses (see cmd/).

entities.name: zazzled version
entities.result: `zazzled VERSION`: the crate's version, `0.0.0-dev` in the repository; release builds write the tag's version into it first (macos/release/set-version.sh). `zazzle version` is answered by the daemon as `zazzle VERSION`, with the same version.
